en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Harith bin Mazaz Jurhami also lived for 400 years;

he composed the following two lines: As if there was no one on way from Hajun to Safa and in Mecca who was a worshipper, who spent the nights in prayers. Yes, we are from the worshippers of Mecca, who spend their nights in worship. We make the passage of days and nights old.
